propositions: rebar ticket store must support encrypted S3 bucket backend via git-remote-s3 helper for sensitive deployments outside GitHub, preserving identical git/event data format and auto-commit/auto-push flow

concurrent/legacy pushes to S3 can leave multiple bundle files for one ref, causing git ls-remote to return conflicting SHAs and new clones to hard-fail with 'multiple updates for ref not allowed', rendering the store unclonable
S3 push operations must fail closed with actionable error when git-remote-s3 helper is absent or below the pinned minimum version, preventing silent multi-bundle corruption

multiple-bundle corruption state must self-heal non-interactively via merge, collapsing all divergent heads to a single bundle while preserving all commits/events from every head, such that git ls-remote returns exactly one bundle and fresh clones succeed
